title: 5A Life-changing Decisions — Идиомы: решения и перемены

items.example: Ashley took the plunge and moved abroad for a year.
Quitting a safe job was a real leap of faith.

items.idiom: cross that bridge when you come to it
items.example: Stop worrying now — cross that bridge when you come to it.
She burned her bridges by resigning before finding a new job.
After signing the contract, they passed the point of no return.
He bit the bullet and chose the harder option.
Stop sitting on the fence — tea or coffee?

items.idiom: caught between a rock and a hard place
items.example: She was caught between a rock and a hard place: love or money?
He always decides on instinct — he goes with his gut.
She followed her heart and chose the music school.
At thirty, he stood at a crossroads of career and family.
The final interview was make-or-break for her.
In a new country it is sink or swim from day one.
That decision became a turning point in his life.
